name: Therapy Charters
summary: A family owned Barbadian charter company running two Pro-Line boats, the 26 ft Dad's Therapy and the 33 ft Mom's Therapy, from a dock in Bridgetown. Every fishing charter is private, from three-hour light tackle trips to full days after marlin and wahoo. They also run two-hour turtle swim and shipwreck snorkel trips.
standouts: Family owned and operated, Barbadian owned
All fishing charters are private, no shared fishing trips
Each boat has its own private restroom
Caters for non-swimmers, special needs and mothers with infants on turtle trips

contact.address: #34 House of Pillars, Cavans Lane Bridgetown Barbados

trips.title: 3hr Lite Tackle Fishing Charter - Private (Dad's Therapy, 26 ft)
trips.summary: A private light tackle trip in shallow water off the south and west coasts, recommended for families and small groups. It suits people who want a hands-on fishing trip without heading out for big game.
highlights: Light tackle fishing in shallow water
Targets amberjack, great barracuda, snapper and grouper
Recommended for families and small groups
Round trip transport option available

trips.title: 4Hr Half Day Fishing Charter - Private (Dad's Therapy, 26 ft)
trips.summary: A private half day of fishing for barracuda, wahoo, tuna and other species, open to beginners and experienced anglers. The crew uses trolling, jigging and live baiting, and your catch can be cleaned to take away or grilled for you.
highlights: For all experience levels
Trolling, jigging and live baiting
Less than 10 minutes to the fishing grounds
Catch cleaned to take away, or grilled for you

Captain swims with guests and takes underwater photos
Caters for non-swimmers, special needs and mothers with infants
